serverInfo.name: Nodsend
serverInfo.description: Human-in-the-loop approval infrastructure for AI agents. One API call to request human approval with signed webhook outcomes.

tools.name: create_approval
tools.description: Create a human approval request for a consequential agent action. The request is delivered to a human via email. The outcome is returned via signed webhook.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the action requiring approval

channel.description: Delivery channel for the approval request

recipient.description: Email address of the human decision-maker

tools.name: check_approval
tools.description: Check the current status of an approval request.

approval_id.description: The approval request ID to cancel
